referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A dark shop photograph carries a left-aligned cream serif promise, one gold booking button and a low service-symbol rail. Small square brand at upper left, sparse service/team/about/contact links and a bordered booking control. High-contrast editorial serif headings against warm sans service details; generous line spacing carries the dark layout. The page sequence runs from shop-photo promise and booking to short practice introduction to service-and-price ledger beside craft photograph toward customer quote, local visit panel, contact footer. Large barber close-up beside a price ledger, then team portrait cards and a small local image rail. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
